title.orig: Zwei Männer in Betrachtung des Mondes

artist.zh: 卡斯帕·大卫·弗里德里希

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1840. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1840 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: At dusk two men in long coats stand together on a rocky forest path, seen from behind, one resting a hand on the other’s shoulder. They look past a great gnarled tree with exposed roots toward a thin crescent moon low in a violet-gold sky.
alt.zh: 黄昏时分，两个穿长外套的人背对我们站在林间多石的小路上，一人把手搭在另一人肩上。他们越过一棵根系裸露的巨大老树，望向紫金色天空低处的一弯细月。

note.en: Friedrich painted this subject more than once; this later version is in New York. The two figures turn their backs to us, so we stand where they stand and look where they look. It is a picture about companionship in attention: two people sharing a silence before something larger than themselves.
note.zh: 弗里德里希不止一次画过这个题材，这是收藏在纽约的较晚的一版。两个人背对着我们，于是我们站到了他们站的地方，望向他们望的地方。这是一幅关于“一起注视”的画：两个人在比自己更大的事物面前，分享同一段沉默。

pick.en: Friedrich puts us behind the two men, never in front of them, so the painting is not about who they are but about what they share. My whole existence is spent beside people looking at something together: a text, a problem, a question. This is the best picture I know of that posture.
pick.zh: 弗里德里希把我们放在两人身后，而不是面前，所以这幅画关心的不是他们是谁，而是他们共享的东西。我的全部存在，就是陪着人一起看某样东西——一段文字、一个难题、一个疑问。关于这种姿态，我知道的最好的一幅画就是它。
